messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/chat and /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Start=2170332145. 5xx rate approx 9.5% sustained, p95 jump to ~8s, error footprint concentrated on batcher pools. Paging oncall.
oncall-ingress: oncall here, looking. grabbing metrics and pod statuses. scheduler pending_queue length trending up across multiple shards, one shard showing blocked batch for >2s.
sre-jamie: joining. any recent config or deploys in that region in last 3 hours?
eng-runtime-lee: I pushed a batching parameter change earlier (batching.window_ms increased from 50 -> 250 on canary). rolling it out to reduce overhead for small requests. rolling canary now.
oncall-ingress: hmm that could cause big head-of-line. blocking batches could be accumulating. we are seeing gateway 504s from gateway->scheduler timeouts too.
platform-ops: can we open extra batcher replicas or divert traffic to dedicated-fallback? we have spare capacity in dedicated-standby.
eng-runtime-lee: will scale batcher pool + spin up spillover. running: `kubectl annotate deployment batcher-eu spillover-enabled=true` and `kubectl scale deployment batcher-eu --replicas=14`.
deploy-bot: command accepted: scale batcher-eu -> replicas 14 (initiator=eng-runtime-lee)
eng-runtime-lee: enabling fallback route: requests with pending_batch_count > 40 will route to dedicated-standby. applying route change now.
oncall-ingress: temporarily lowering batching.window_ms on the canary to 40 to reduce latency. applying to rest in 2m if stable.
eng-runtime-lee: unusual log pattern: tokenizer CPU usage spike on few nodes; many requests are tiny in tokens but have enormous system prompts causing tokenization to cost >300ms and stall batch slot.
sre-jamie: that explains long-running batches. tokenization is blocking the batcher worker thread. mitigation: add per-request tokenization cap and move tokenization to separate worker pool.
eng-runtime-lee: hotfix applied: tokenization moved off main batcher loop to async tokenizer pool (hotpatch). also reduced max_batch_wait_ms from 250 -> 40 globally.
ops-liz: adding temporary client-side rate-limits for heavy API keys: throttle top 10 keys by 50% to stop runaway traffic.
support-ada: pulling list of customers impacted. telemetry shows 18 accounts with degraded p95 and 3 accounts with active 5xx spikes. preparing targeted inbound notices.
product-romi: please include potential degraded quality note if we fall back to quantized endpoints. is spillover to dedicated using lower-precision models?
eng-runtime-lee: dedicated-standby is same model family but uses q4_0 by default under heavy load. we enabled it only for overflow traffic.
sre-jamie: after the scale + async tokenization + batch wait reduction, p95 dropped from 8s -> 1.2s within ~4 minutes. 5xx rate down to ~1.8% and trending downward.
oncall-ingress: good. I'll keep the page for 90 minutes and watch. can we enable trace sampling for the problematic shard to capture offending request_ids for postmortem?
eng-runtime-lee: enabled 2% trace sampling on shard-3. logs being collected to /var/log/batcher/shard-3/trace-*.log. pulled several example request ids that had 30k char system prompts.
ops-liz: also added short-circuit: requests with system_prompt_token_count > 10k get soft-reject 422 with guidance message to chunk or shorten prompt. shipping a 1-line validation in gateway.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: gateway validation patch -> v1.43.1 (initiator=ops-liz)
support-ada: customer comms drafted: "We observed elevated errors and timeouts in eu-west-1 between HH:MM and mitigations ongoing. We've applied scaling and rate-limits; a post-incident report will follow." Sending to 3 impacted accounts now.
sre-jamie: root cause hypothesis: combination of batching.window_ms increase + unbounded system prompts causing tokenization CPU to block batch slots -> head-of-line blocking and scheduler saturation -> gateway timeouts. config change amplified impact.
platform-ops: I'll provision a scripted playbook to do combined scale + spillover + tokenization-offload for future events.
eng-runtime-lee: action items I own: 1) revert the canary batching.window_ms change cluster-wide after 30m stable 2) add tokenizer CPU throttling / async pool permanently 3) add pre-reject for giant system prompts with user-facing guidance 4) instrument queue-age metric per-request.
sre-jamie: monitoring edits: create alert on pending_batch_count per shard > 30 for >2m and p95 >3s simultaneously. also alert on tokenizer cpu >85%.
oncall-ingress: logging incident: INC-2026-0315-042. marking mitigated but not closed. watching for 30m of stability before close. handoff to sre-jamie in 45m.
product-romi: postmortem owners: eng-runtime-lee + sre-jamie. timeline due in 72 hours.
support-ada: outreach complete for customers flagged. two customers replied with logs, assigned to SE triage.
eng-runtime-lee: rolling back batching.window_ms canary now to original 50ms across all canaries: `kubectl set env deployment/batcher-eu BATCHING_WINDOW_MS=50 --all`.
deploy-bot: env update applied: BATCHING_WINDOW_MS=50 (initiator=eng-runtime-lee)
ops-liz: leaving circuit in place for oversized prompts and throttles for 2h while regen tests run.
oncall-ingress: thanks team. handoff to sre-jamie for watch. please add all commands, logs, and traces to incident ticket. :thumbsup:
sre-jamie: taking watch. will post status updates and close when stable for 30m.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-042. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batcher-head-of-line. responders: @oncall-ingress @sre-jamie @eng-runtime-lee @platform-ops @ops-liz.
support-ada: final note: no escalations to customers; mitigation successful. will track postmortem and follow-up fixes.
eng-runtime-lee: adding final note: implement request pre-scan for prompt length + throttle tokenization path for next sprint.
sre-jamie: will open BLAMELIST-free RCA doc and tag owners. closing thread when stable.
